semantic_layer: complete labelled relation panels; scene geometry is illustrative
partial_goal: positive conjunctive constraints; unlisted facts unconstrained
overflow: VALID_STOP; never truncate facts or silently resize text
profile_transformations: none authorized by default; compatibility failures stop before collection; transformations require a recorded successor profile/task binding, never silent changes to authoritative PDDL

trace_mapping.coverage: Every distinct replayed state used as an observation or accepted transition result in the complete selected reasoning episode, including off-solution branches; also any state explicitly exposed by an observation adapter.
trace_mapping.state_reuse: Reuse the first canonical occurrence within a task, keyed by semantic state equality (atoms and fluents); no hashes. Distinct tasks never share an assumed state identity.
trace_mapping.binding: decision observation -> source state image; accepted runtime result -> successor state image; goal -> task-level partial-goal image
trace_mapping.model_input: Current observation state image plus partial-goal image only; identical bounded Search Memory. Never attach future/result images before the operation producing them.
trace_mapping.model_output: Canonical rationale and Typed Search Operation remain text; runtime result is trusted execution evidence.
trace_mapping.paths: Use replayed root-to-node Action Sequences from search parent links, not only the solution plan. Cover shared prefixes once where possible; non-goal search paths are supplied sequences, not solver requests.
trace_mapping.initial_state: Reuse the initial frame from a non-empty supplied path; an episode with no non-empty path must explicitly stop under the active supplied-plan renderer contract.
trace_mapping.goal_image: Partial constraints, not a rendered complete solved state; one reusable goal image per task.
trace_mapping.invalid_operation: No invented successor image for an invalid operation; retain the charged failure and unchanged authoritative state.
trace_mapping.not_required: A full search-tree image or fresh renders of every frontier/visited entry at each decision; no unbounded image history.
